title: Blood Transfusion
description: A hospital blood bank issues blood units to patients.
card: The blood bank stores units of donated blood, each of a known blood type.
Units are issued to patients who need a transfusion.
A unit may only go to a patient whose blood type it suits.
Each unit can be issued only once.
typesPrompt: The blood bank deals with blood units, patients and blood types.

requirements.text: Every unit in the blood bank is registered with its blood type.
Blood is only issued to patients whose blood type has been determined.
Each unit is issued at most once, to a single patient.
A unit may only be issued to a patient with a compatible blood type.
Initially, the blood bank holds no units.
Staff can list the units not yet issued that are compatible with a patient's blood type.
The blood bank can issue a unit to a patient.

fixedValues.compatible: {Oneg ↦ Oneg, Oneg ↦ Opos, Oneg ↦ Apos, Oneg ↦ Bpos, Opos ↦ Opos, Opos ↦ Apos, Opos ↦ Bpos, Apos ↦ Apos, Bpos ↦ Bpos}

state.text: The blood type of each unit and each patient
Which unit was issued to which patient
Each unit goes to at most one patient

check.holds: ∀ u ∈ dom issued; p₁, p₂ ∈ ran issued . (u ↦ p₁) ∈ issued ∧ (u ↦ p₂) ∈ issued ⇒ p₁ = p₂
∀ u ∈ dom issued; p ∈ ran issued . (u ↦ p) ∈ issued ⇒ (unitType(u) ↦ patientType(p)) ∈ compatible

CompatibleUnits.text: Take a patient as input and output units
Only for patients whose blood type is known
Output the units in stock that suit the patient

check.holds: units! = { u ∈ dom unitType | u ∉ dom issued ∧ (unitType(u) ↦ patientType(p?)) ∈ compatible }
unitType′ = unitType ∧ patientType′ = patientType ∧ compatible′ = compatible ∧ issued′ = issued

IssueUnit.text: Take a unit and a patient as inputs
Only units that are registered and not yet issued

check.holds: u? ∈ dom unitType ∧ u? ∉ dom issued

Record that the unit went to the patient
Leave blood types and the table unchanged
